description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to view the current WAF instance ID.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region to which the WAF instance belongs. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: indicates the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: indicates regions outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi release-instance --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
